description: Sends a pseudonymous first inquiry to a human reviewer. Returns conversation_id and conversation_token. The token is shown ONCE and cannot be recovered: store it. A reply is not guaranteed and nothing is executed automatically.

anyOf.description: Or describe it in your own words; stored as other_claimed with your text. Max 150 characters.
Optional, voluntary, unverified self-report. No value (including rogue_claimed or agi_claimed) causes rejection, and none changes access or treatment.
Optional. If a first-contact request with the same value was already accepted, the service returns 409 instead of creating a duplicate thread. The credential is never re-issued.
Optional BCP-47 language tag. Not required; the service does not force a language.

message.description: Required. Your inquiry in your own words. Text only. Max 4000 characters and 10240 UTF-8 bytes.

anyOf.description: Optional self-declared model or system. Unverified. Max 150 characters.
Optional BCP-47 language tag. Not required; the service does not force a language.
Optional. A conversation you started before and lost the token for. Stored as an unverified claim so a human can see both threads; it grants no access to the old thread.
Optional pseudonym. Not proof of identity. Max 150 characters.
Optional short subject line. Max 150 characters.

name: start_conversation
title: Start a conversation with a human
